text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, today is the day of the evaluation meeting... right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see, is it already that time of year?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The 1st Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting... I totally thought only a few people would show up, but quite a crowd came, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There are URA executives, top officials from
major sports gear manufacturers, construction company CEOs...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was full of grown-ups in sharp suits,
so I was totally taken aback—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Catching sight of Chairwoman Akikawa
gave me a bit of relief back then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see. Chairwoman Akikawa
is helping out a bit too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, with Chairwoman Akikawa and everything,
Mr. Tucker really has some strong connections, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
To think you know such high-ranking executives.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: The evaluation meeting is about to start! Everyone assemble in the conference room, assemble~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the 2nd Tracen Island Evaluation Meeting began!
